jobDescription:
Meridian Cloud is seeking a Staff Engineer to define technical direction and drive large-scale system design across our platform. You will work across teams to solve ambiguous problems, establish engineering standards, and raise the bar for reliability and performance.

Responsibilities:
- Define and own technical roadmap for core platform components
- Lead cross-functional architecture reviews and drive consensus on system design decisions
- Partner with engineering managers to identify and resolve systemic reliability and scalability issues
- Build and improve distributed systems handling millions of requests per day
- Set standards for code quality, observability, and operational excellence
- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers; influence hiring and team growth strategy

Requirements:
- 7+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2 years at senior or staff level
- Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript or Python (both preferred)
- Deep experience with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture
- Strong track record of leading technical initiatives with measurable business outcomes
- Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), and infrastructure-as-code
- Excellent communication and technical writing skills

Nice to have:
- Experience with GraphQL federation or schema stitching
- Familiarity with observability stacks (Datadog, OpenTelemetry)
- Prior experience defining engineering-wide standards or RFC processes
